messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: p99 latency breach detected for /v1/stream (region: us-west-2) — paging oncall. auto-escalation level=prod-high :rotating_light:

incident-bot: metrics snapshot attached, recent deploy: model-quant-profile@2025-02-18T03:21Z (fp8-calibration)

alex: ack — I got the page, jumping in. seeing alert for streaming tail.

jamal: I can take triage. who rolled the fp8 calibration? iirc that landed ~03:21 UTC in the canary pool.

maria: that was my change — tuned activation quant ranges for long-context to reduce cost. can confirm it rolled canary->prod at ~03:21 after autosuccess.

sre-lead: timeline pls. p95/p99 numbers? customers impacted?

incident-bot: ```
/v1/stream - window 03:15-03:35 UTC
p95: 410ms (SLO 300ms)
p99: 2.3s (SLO 800ms)
stream-stall-rate: 1.8% (baseline 0.04%)
request-rate: +8% steady
error-rate: 0.38% (timeouts + aborted streams)
recent-deploy: model-quant-profile@2025-02-18T03:21Z (fp8-calib)
```

alex: seeing GC/backpressure on the serving nodes? GPU mem elevated and dequant ops spiking on runtime logs. paste of runtime tail: ```
2025-02-18T03:23:10Z runtime: kv-cache-miss 0.42 -> dequant fallback start
2025-02-18T03:23:11Z runtime: dequantize kernel fallback (fp32 path) latency +320ms
2025-02-18T03:23:12Z stream: stall detected, client=svc-x, duration=1.3s
```

eng-runtime: this smells like calibration fallout where the fp8 ranges cause frequent dequant transitions and increased host-side work for certain long-token sequences. KV cache alignment maybe off causing repeated dequant cycles.

jamal: quick mitigation proposal: 1) rollback fp8 calibration profile to previous quant profile 2) route /v1/stream traffic to model-variant:fp32-fallback (hot route) 3) scale dedicated streaming pool by +20% for cold-start buffer. we can do 1 & 2 fast.

maria: i can roll back the quant profile immediately. preparing revert CL now.

oncall-bot: @jamal assigned incident at 03:25 UTC — oncall: jamal. paging escalation sent to sre-lead@03:26 UTC.

jamal: @maria go ahead with rollback, i'll kick the routing change. alex please confirm the runtime readiness for routing to fp32-fallback variant (no model change, only runtime route).

alex: routing check ok, runtime has fp32 fallback variant warmed in us-west-2. will start traffic cutover with gradual 10% steps.

maria: rollback done: `git revert model-quant-profile@2025-02-18T03:21Z` -> applied to canary then prod. canary confirm no regressions. pushing prod now (03:29 UTC).

incident-bot: PROD CONFIG CHANGE: quant-profile set to model-quant-profile@2025-02-17T22:11Z (pre-calib) at 03:30 UTC.

alex: starting routing shift -> /v1/stream 10% -> fp32-fallback at 03:31, 50% at 03:33, 100% at 03:35. monitoring p99.

incident-bot: 03:34 snapshot: p99 dropped to 920ms (was 2.3s), stream-stall-rate 0.12%. still above SLO but improving.

cs-ops: heads-up, CS: a few enterprise customers reported interrupted streams and truncated outputs — CS notified and we opened interim incident notices. No confirmed data leakage.

sre-lead: good. continue mitigation. next steps: keep routing to fp32-fallback until 2 hours post-stable metrics OR until eng-runtime validates a safe recalibration.

eng-runtime: working on a safer recalibration plan: additional offline calibration sweeps, KV-cache warmup changes, and a mitigation toggle that prevents repeated dequant thrashing. will aim for canary in 24-36hrs after tests.

jamal: marking live mitigation done for now. current status: rollback applied, routing to fp32 fallback at 100%, p99 ~380ms, p95 ~260ms, stream-stall-rate ~0.05% (03:40 UTC).

incident-bot: PAGING: incident moved to postmortem and monitoring. severity -> Sev2 (customer impact limited, partial SLO breaches).

maria: sorry team — i missed the long-context edge-case during calibration tests. will own postmortem and follow-ups.

alex: logging immediate RCA notes: root cause probable combination of fp8 calibration edge-case + KV-cache alignment mismatch causing repeated dequant fallbacks on long token prefixes -> host-side CPU/backpressure -> streaming stalls at p99.

cs-ops: CS action items: notify affected customers with summary + ETA for safe recalibration. assigned to @cs-ops.

sre-lead: handoff: i'm taking ownership for stability until 06:00 UTC. jamal you remain primary oncall. please file incident ticket and include these actions:
- timeline + metric graphs
- full list of affected tenants
- changelog of quant-profile commit + revert
- runbook amendments for quant calibrations (add long-context simulation)

jamal: creating incident ticket now (INC-2025-2157) and adding todos.

maria: will run extended calibration tests with synthetic long-context sequences and KV warmup emulation. will also add a safety gate to block fp8 rollouts if stream-stall-rate > 0.1% in canary.

alex: closing the live mitigation thread; we'll reconvene in the postmortem channel in ~24h. thanks all. :pray:
